Volume 4's OCR re-read (T-0775) carries 0 column slivers, measured under T-0810: the byte-exact rule T-0601 wrote cannot hold across an OCR reading, whose two readings of the crop overlap come from two tesseract runs, so the volume was scanned again by positional character agreement over the common prefix of every column-boundary pair. That measure scores all eight slivers in volumes 1-3 at 1.000 and volume 4's 21 boundary pairs at 0.216 or below. Every volume's scan is now stated in records/ as sliver_scan and re-derived by --check, so a zero is a measured zero rather than an unasked question.
